I2-004.scope: Existing I2.1.2.2-specific approval only; edition and synthetic eligibility explicitly assumed.
I2-004.decision: Ready for a separately authorized fresh pair, not a continuation or seeded generation.

I2-005.scope: Absent approval: distinct I2.2.5 boundary-point population and source-edition selection needed.
I2-005.representation: ship -> hasBottomRegionLowerRegionBoundaryPoint -> hullBoundaryPoint -> shellInclinationAngle; decimal degrees.

IMO-001.scope: Absent approval. Native document identifies MSC.385(94), adopted 21 November 2014; no catalog edition/authority/provenance selection support.
IMO-001.representation: designIceCondition and shipCategory object properties, controlled individuals available. Definition of mediumFirstYearIceWithPossibleOldIceInclusions explicitly says at least medium first-year ice.
IMO-001.limitation: A finite represented design-condition population can be proposed, but do not interpret the clause as requiring every ship to be Category A or silently certify a general severity hierarchy. Conditional definition and absent inputs require source/representation adjudication.

TRF-010.scope: Absent approval. Native document TRAFICOM/68863/03.04.01.00/2021 identifies 2021 edition; catalog lacks admission metadata. Section 1.1 explicitly applies section 1.8 to all ships irrespective of build year; do not inherit I2 dates.
TRF-010.representation: All six canonical ice-class individuals available from ontology even if absent registry entries.
TRF-010.limitation: Class-record vocabulary validation does not independently establish structure, power or capabilities described by each class. Act 1121/2005 section 3 is referenced; unresolved reference materiality must be reviewed, not automatically assumed resolved.

TRF-035.scope: Absent approval. Distinct construction/date/application scope for section 4.1.1 needed; no blanket section 1.8 exception. Catalog metadata missing as for TRF-010.
TRF-035.representation: Both length quantities are direct ship-owned decimal metres. Ontology explicitly calls classificationSocietyRuleLength a linked requirement operand and recommended unit M, but flags development unit selected and fixture conversion required. No equivalentProperty assertion was found between the two properties in the inspected subjects.
TRF-035.limitation: Compare submitted L against an independently supplied society rule-length datum only under an explicitly declared representation; do not derive society rules from its name. Classification-society identity/provenance is not proof of the value. bow/midbody/stern are individuals despite ownership-map entries: retain kind checks rather than treating them as quantity paths.

I2-042.decision: DEFERRED; excluded from all proposed dispatch and evaluation inventories.
